feedback: Written before the final race. The Builder's geometry is the iteration 8 design, which scored 71.37, the best of all races. The Integrator kept the iteration 8 controller unchanged, because no gain was ever isolated from the geometry. The controller needed three compensations for this geometry, all visible in the race history. First, the seven-sensor row at 20 mm spacing needed weights scaled to about 33 times x (iteration 5), because the outer sensors at +/-0.06 m would otherwise dominate the signal. Second, the lighter 0.4 kg body needed kd raised from 0.25 to 0.30, since steering oscillation rose on the s-bend and slalom (0.173 and 0.168 against 0.161 at 0.6 kg in iteration 7). Third, last_direction line recovery was needed, because the outer sensors still lose the line once per run at the 0.06 m floor. Iteration 8 is the evidence for this package. Its controller and geometry were measured together, so any single-field change would be untested. If the final race (unseen track) shows max_error near 0.062 to 0.066 m and line loss of about 1 on curves, the limit is the fixed off-track floor, and no body or sensor change from this design is expected to lift it. Changes to wheel_radius have been tested at 0.025, 0.030 and 0.034 m, and 0.030 m was the best. Mass and track are at their minimums. No further geometry change is recommended.
requested_changes: No change: keep the iteration 8 geometry (0.4 kg, 0.08 m track, 0.03 m wheel radius, seven 12 mm sensors at 20 mm spacing, y = 0.07 m, span +/-0.06 m) unchanged, because it is the best measured design (71.37) and each one-parameter change from it scored lower in iterations 9 and 10.
